prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on what you want. Do you want UV tanning beds, a spray (sunless) tan, a mobile airbrush tech, the cheapest option, or a luxury salon? Also tell me roughly what part of Charlotte (zip code or neighborhood) and any budget or skin-sensitivity concerns.

While you answer, here are quick tips for choosing the best salon and what to look for:

What to consider
- Service type: spray/sunless (airbrush or booth) vs UV beds. Spray is safer; UV risks include premature aging and skin cancer.
- Technician skill: look for before/after photos, certifications, and in-person consultations for spray tans.
- Cleanliness and equipment: well-maintained beds/booths, fresh towels, and a clean reception area.
- Product quality: for spray tans, ask about brands (e.g., DHA concentration, bronzers) and odor/fast-dry formulas.
- Reviews and ratings: check Google, Yelp, Facebook for recent reviews and photos.
- Patch test & allergy policies: reputable places offer a patch test or will discuss ingredients.
- Pricing, packages & memberships: good salons often have introductory offers or loyalty plans.

Safety tips
- For spray tans: exfoliate beforehand, avoid lotion/oils right before your session, follow aftercare (no shower for the recommended time).
- For UV beds: get a skin assessment, limit exposure, use eye protection, and follow recommended session schedules.
- Consider alternatives: gradual self-tanners, bronzing lotions, or professional spray tans if you want to avoid UV.

If you give me your neighborhood or zip code (or say whether you prefer spray vs UV), I’ll list highly recommended options in Charlotte and summarize what each is best known for.
